lead: Test build 0.8.21b (CI run 39027398548, branch round-0.8.21): after the comparison with the original - popup menus open at their control with 25 entries per column, a right click opens the Wavetable list through the ring, the HyperSaw display follows the original exactly, PATCH UTILITY > INFO shows TI Revive, broker and Virus OS versions, and the REMOTE page shows the template list (read-only). Already passed with the first build: Linux L1/L2, VM W1. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Disposable DAW project only. No firmware or OS update, no "Burn To Flash", no factory reset, no storing patches. On the REMOTE page: no SAVE, no LOAD (they are not active in TI Revive yet).
Order: Linux (Claude brings the Virus back from the Windows 10 VM), then the Windows 11 VM, macOS, and Windows 11 on this PC last.
Close the DAW before moving the Virus to another machine.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Claude unpacked the test build to ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21b-linux. In a terminal: cd ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21b-linux/TI-Revive-0.8.21-linux && sudo ./install.sh
notes: The first start after the install reads the Virus' OS version once (about 3 s longer before the sync starts).

items.title: Popup menus
steps: OSC page, oscillator 1 Wavetable: right-click the table name "Sine".
BROWSER: click the bank bar above a bank, and the category field.
items.expect: the right click opens the list of 100 tables in 4 columns at the name; the left click turns the ring; the bank list opens just below the bar, the category list over its field.

items.title: HyperSaw display
steps: Oscillator 1 HyperSaw: turn the ring (Density) from left to right, then set DETUNE to 0 and 127.
items.expect: 2 to 9 vertical lines, the last one growing; DETUNE spreads them from the middle to almost the full width.

items.title: INFO box and REMOTE page
steps: PATCH UTILITY > CONFIG: look at the INFO box.
items.expect: INFO: TI Revive 0.8.21 in the five version rows, Virus TI Version 5.1.7.00, the website link text. REMOTE: 32 x Init Template, a click highlights the template, nothing else changes.

sections.title: Windows 11 VM
prep: Close REAPER. Claude installs the test build in the VM and hands over the Virus with VM=win11 scripts/vm.sh attach.

items.title: Smoke test and Wavetable list
steps: Open the test project, play, open the editor.
Oscillator 1 Wavetable: right-click "Sine", pick another table.
items.expect: sound; the list opens in 4 columns at the name; the chosen table shows in the display.

items.title: INFO box
items.expect: the same versions as on Linux, Virus TI Version 5.1.7.00.

sections.title: macOS
prep: Claude pushes the package to the Mac when it is awake: ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21b-mac. In Terminal: sudo installer -pkg ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21b-mac/"TI Revive.pkg" -target /
notes: macOS draws its own popup menus: columns and position may look different there.

items.title: Smoke test
steps: Start Ableton, play, open the editor.

items.title: Oscillator displays and menus
steps: Classic: WaveSelect 1, 2, 30 with Shape left; HyperSaw: turn Density.
items.expect: sine, triangle, a third wave; 2..9 HyperSaw lines; the table list opens.

sections.title: Windows 11 on this PC
sections.where: boot into Windows; Claude is not available during it
prep: Download the 0.8.21 .msi (not the setup.exe) from github.com/derpsn/access-virus-ti-revive/actions/runs/39027398548 (artifact "TI-Revive-msi", GitHub login).
notes: Before: Installed apps shows three TI Revive entries (0.8.0, 0.8.20 and 0.8.20). Reboot to Linux at the end; Claude reads C:\ProgramData\TI Revive\bundles.log read-only.

items.title: The .msi cleans up the old entries
steps: Installed apps: search for "TI Revive" and note what you see.
Install the 0.8.21 .msi, then search again (reopen Settings).
items.expect: afterwards exactly one entry, TI Revive 0.8.21.

items.title: Smoke test and INFO box
steps: Ableton: play, open the editor, PATCH UTILITY > CONFIG.
items.expect: sound; Virus TI Version 5.1.7.00 in the INFO box.
